title.zh: 一门婚事试出的“去意”：吴起为什么离开魏国
title.en: A Marriage Offer as a Test: Why Wu Qi Left Wei

dek.zh: 吴起替魏国守住西河，连当时的宰相田文都承认功劳不如他。后来的魏相公叔忌恨他，想把他赶走，设了一个两步的局：先劝国君把公主许配给吴起，再请吴起到家里，看自己的公主妻子当面轻慢自己。吴起辞了婚，国君起了疑心，不再信他。
dek.en: Wu Qi held Wei's western frontier at Xihe, and even Tian Wen, chief minister at the time, admitted that his record was the greater. A later chief minister, Gongshu, resented him and wanted to drive him out, so he laid a two-step trap: persuade the ruler to offer Wu Qi a princess in marriage, then bring Wu Qi home to watch Gongshu's own wife, a princess, treat her husband with contempt. Wu Qi declined the marriage, and the ruler grew suspicious and stopped trusting him.

heading.en: A Scene in the Chief Minister's House

paras.zh: 魏国宰相公叔的妻子，是魏国的一位公主。一天，公叔请大将吴起一同回家；当着吴起的面，公主发起脾气，对自己的丈夫很不客气。国君魏武侯要把一位公主许配给吴起，吴起见了公叔家这一幕，推辞了这门婚事。武侯从此怀疑他，不再信任他。吴起怕获罪，离开魏国，去了楚国。
paras.en: The wife of Gongshu, chief minister of the state of Wei, was a princess of Wei. One day Gongshu brought the general Wu Qi home with him, and in front of their guest the princess flew into a temper and treated her husband with contempt. Marquis Wu, the ruler of Wei, wanted to give Wu Qi a princess in marriage; having seen that scene in Gongshu's house, Wu Qi declined. From then on the marquis suspected him and no longer trusted him. Afraid of being punished, Wu Qi left Wei for the state of Chu.

paras.zh: 那场脾气和那门婚事都不是巧合，而是公叔按照自家仆人的计策一手安排的。一位替魏国守住西河、连公叔的前任宰相田文都承认功劳不如他的将军，为什么一门婚事就让他在魏国待不下去？
paras.en: Neither the temper nor the marriage offer was an accident: both were arranged by Gongshu, following a plan from one of his own servants. How could a single marriage offer drive out a general who had held Wei's western frontier, and whose record even Tian Wen, the chief minister before Gongshu, admitted was greater than his own?

heading.zh: 上一次被疑，也因为一桩婚姻
heading.en: The First Time He Was Suspected, It Was Also About a Marriage

paras.zh: 吴起是卫国人，喜欢用兵，早年在鲁国做事。他第一次被人怀疑，就和婚姻有关：齐国攻打鲁国，鲁国想让他领兵，可他的妻子是齐国人，鲁国不放心。吴起想成就功名，竟杀了妻子，表明自己和齐国没有牵连。鲁国这才让他做将军，他领兵攻齐，大败齐军。
paras.en: Wu Qi came from the state of Wey and loved warfare. As a young man he served the state of Lu, and the first time he fell under suspicion, it was over a marriage. When Qi attacked Lu, Lu wanted him to command its army, but his wife was from Qi and Lu did not trust him. Eager to make his name, Wu Qi killed his wife to show he had no tie to Qi. Only then did Lu make him a general, and he led its army against Qi and routed it.

paras.zh: 仗打赢了，鲁国却有人在国君面前指责他，说吴起「猜忍」，意思是为人多疑狠厉。这人翻出他的旧事：年轻时家有千金，出外求官不成，把家产败光，被乡邻嘲笑，他杀了三十多个讥讽他的人，离开卫国；临走咬破胳膊向母亲发誓，不做卿相不回卫国；后来母亲去世，他也没有回去，老师曾子因此和他断绝来往。这人还替鲁君算了一笔账：鲁国是小国，有了打胜仗的名声，各国就会来打鲁国的主意；鲁、卫是兄弟之国，重用吴起，等于抛弃卫国。鲁君起了疑心，辞退了吴起。吴起听说魏国国君魏文侯贤明，便去投奔魏国。
paras.en: After the victory, someone in Lu denounced him to its ruler, charging that Wu Qi was suspicious and ruthless. The accuser dug up his past: as a young man from a rich family he had sought office abroad and failed, squandering the family fortune; when his neighbours laughed at him, he killed more than thirty of those who mocked him and left Wey. Parting from his mother, he bit his arm and swore never to return to Wey until he was a chief minister. When his mother later died he did not go back, and his teacher Zengzi broke with him. The accuser also did the sums for Lu's ruler: Lu was a small state, and a name for victories would make the other states eye it greedily; Lu and Wey were brother states, so to employ Wu Qi was to abandon Wey. The ruler of Lu grew suspicious and dismissed him. Hearing that Marquis Wen, the ruler of Wei, was a worthy ruler, Wu Qi went to serve him.

heading.en: From Governor of Xihe to the Refused Marriage

paras.zh: 魏文侯先问李克，吴起是个什么样的人。李克的评价毁誉参半：「起貪而好色，然用兵司馬穰苴不能過也」，说吴起贪婪又好色，可论带兵，连司马穰苴也超不过他。吴起带兵，和最下等的士兵吃穿一样，睡觉不铺席子，行军不骑马坐车，自己背粮食。有个士兵生了毒疮，吴起亲口替他吸脓。士兵的母亲听说后大哭：当年吴将军也替孩子的父亲吸过疮，他父亲打仗从不回头，死在敌阵里；如今又替她儿子吸，她不知道儿子会死在哪里了。文侯看重吴起会用兵、廉洁公平、深得士兵之心，派他镇守西河，抵御秦国和韩国。
paras.en: Marquis Wen first asked Li Ke what sort of man Wu Qi was. Li Ke's verdict was mixed: Wu Qi was greedy and fond of women, but in the use of troops not even Sima Rangju could surpass him. As a commander, Wu Qi dressed and ate like the lowest of his soldiers, slept without a mat, marched instead of riding, and carried his own rations. When one soldier had an abscess, Wu Qi sucked out the pus himself. The soldier's mother wept when she heard. Years before, she said, General Wu had done the same for the boy's father, who then fought without ever turning back and died among the enemy; now he had done it for her son, and she did not know where her son would die. Valuing Wu Qi's skill with troops, his honesty and fairness, and the loyalty he won from his men, Marquis Wen made him governor of Xihe, to hold off Qin and Han.

paras.zh: 魏文侯去世后，吴起转而事奉他的儿子武侯。这时魏国任命宰相，用了田文。吴起很不高兴，去找田文比功劳。他一连比了三件事。统领三军，让士兵乐意为国拼命，敌国不敢打魏国的主意，你比我怎样？田文说：「不如子」，不如你。镇守西河，让秦兵不敢向东进犯，韩、赵两国都来归附，你比我怎样？田文还是说不如你。治理百官、亲近百姓、充实国库，你比我怎样？田文仍说不如你。三件比完，吴起问：这三件你都在我之下，职位却在我之上，这是为什么？
paras.en: After Marquis Wen died, Wu Qi served his son, Marquis Wu. Wei then appointed a chief minister and chose Tian Wen. Wu Qi was displeased and challenged Tian Wen to compare their merits. He compared them on three counts. In command of the armies, making soldiers glad to die and enemy states afraid to plot against Wei, how do you compare with me? Tian Wen said: Not as well as you. Holding Xihe, so that Qin's troops dare not march east and Han and Zhao come as guests, how do you compare with me? Again Tian Wen said he could not match him. Governing the officials, winning the people's affection and filling the treasury, how do you compare with me? Once more Tian Wen said he could not match him. When the three were done, Wu Qi asked: in all three you rank below me, yet your post ranks above mine. Why?

paras.zh: 田文的回答只有一句：「主少國疑，大臣未附，百姓不信，方是之時，屬之於子乎？屬之於我乎？」意思是：国君年纪还轻，国中人心疑惧，大臣还没有归心，百姓也还不信任朝廷；在这样的时候，国家大事是托付给你，还是托付给我？田文没有否认吴起的战功。吴起比的是个人功劳，田文问的是眼下谁来担当一国的重任。吴起沉默了很久，说：「屬之子矣」，托付给你。田文说，这就是我位在你之上的原因。史书接着写，吴起这才知道自己不如田文。
paras.en: Tian Wen answered with a single question. The ruler is young and the state uneasy, he said; the great ministers have not yet rallied to him and the common people do not yet trust the government. At such a time, is the state to be entrusted to you, or to me? Tian Wen did not deny Wu Qi's victories. Wu Qi had been comparing personal merit; Tian Wen was asking who should carry the state at that moment. Wu Qi was silent for a long time, then said: To you. That, said Tian Wen, is why I rank above you. The history adds that Wu Qi then knew he was not Tian Wen's equal.

paras.zh: 田文死后，公叔做了宰相。公叔娶的是魏国公主，他忌恨吴起，想把他赶走。公叔的仆人说：吴起很容易赶走。公叔问怎么办，仆人先说吴起的为人：「吳起為人節廉而自喜名也」，有节操、清廉，又看重自己的名声。接着献上一个两步的计策。
paras.en: After Tian Wen died, Gongshu became chief minister. Gongshu was married to a princess of Wei, and he resented Wu Qi and wanted to drive him out. His servant said: Wu Qi is easy to drive away. When Gongshu asked how, the servant first described the man: Wu Qi had integrity, kept his hands clean, and prized his good name. Then he laid out a plan in two steps.

paras.zh: 仆人的计策是：第一步，公叔先去对武侯说：吴起是个贤人，可是您的国家小，又和强大的秦国接壤，我私下担心吴起没有长久留下的心。照仆人的设计，武侯会问：那怎么办？公叔就建议「試延以公主」，拿把公主许配给吴起来试探他：有心留下，一定会接受；无心留下，一定会推辞，「以此卜之」，就用这件事来占卜他的去留。第二步，公叔再请吴起到家里，让自己娶的那位公主当着吴起的面发怒、轻慢公叔。仆人断定，吴起看到公主这样轻贱自己的丈夫，一定会推辞这门婚事。
paras.en: The servant's plan: in step one, Gongshu would tell Marquis Wu that Wu Qi was a man of worth, but that the marquis's state was small and bordered on mighty Qin, and he privately feared Wu Qi had no mind to stay. In the servant's script, the marquis would ask what to do. Gongshu would then propose testing Wu Qi with the offer of a princess: if he meant to stay he would surely accept, and if not he would surely decline, so the offer would serve as a divination of his intentions. In step two, Gongshu would then invite Wu Qi home and have the princess he had married flare up and slight him in front of Wu Qi. Seeing a princess treat her husband with such contempt, the servant predicted, Wu Qi would surely turn the marriage down.

paras.zh: 事情一如仆人所料。吴起见公主轻贱魏相，果然推辞了武侯的婚事。武侯「疑之而弗信」，从此怀疑他，不再信任他。吴起怕获罪，就离开魏国，去了楚国。
paras.en: It went exactly as the servant had foretold. Seeing the princess scorn the chief minister of Wei, Wu Qi declined Marquis Wu's offer. The marquis grew suspicious and no longer trusted him. Afraid of being punished, Wu Qi left Wei and went to Chu.

paras.zh: 在楚国，楚悼王早就听说他贤能，让他做了宰相。他严明法令，裁掉不急需的官员，罢免与王室血缘疏远的公族，集中力量强兵，楚国强盛起来，各国都忧虑楚国的强大。史书写道，因此楚国的贵戚都想害他。悼王一死，王族大臣作乱，攻击吴起；吴起跑到悼王遗体处，伏在遗体上，攻击他的人又射又刺吴起，也击中了悼王的遗体。悼王下葬、太子即位后，下令把射吴起时也射中了王尸的人全部处死，因此被灭族的有七十多家。
paras.en: In Chu, King Dao, who had long heard of his ability, made him chief minister. He made the laws clear and strict, cut offices that were not needed, dismissed royal kinsmen of distant blood, and put the state's strength into its army; Chu grew strong, and the other states feared its power. For this reason, the history says, Chu's nobles all wanted him dead. When King Dao died, members of the royal clan rose up and attacked Wu Qi. He ran to the king's body and threw himself on it; his attackers shot and stabbed him, and struck the king's body too. After King Dao was buried and the crown prince came to the throne, he had everyone who had shot at Wu Qi and also struck the king's body put to death, and more than seventy families were wiped out for it.

paras.zh: 作者推断：这个局把一个谁也说不清的问题，吴起心里想不想留下，换成了一个看得见的动作：接不接这门婚事。设计者又事先算准了他的答案：一个看重名声的人，刚看见公主怎样对待做宰相的丈夫，多半不肯接这门亲。两步连起来，吴起的推辞出于他的性情，到了武侯那里，却正好成了“无心留下”的证据。在鲁国，他用杀妻来证明自己没有二心；在魏国，一次拒婚就被当成了去意。
paras.en: The author's inference: the trap turned a question no one could settle, whether Wu Qi meant to stay, into an act anyone could see: would he accept the marriage or not? And its designer had worked out his answer in advance. A man who prized his good name, having just seen how a princess treated her husband the chief minister, would very likely refuse such a match. Put together, the two steps made a refusal that came from his own character look, to the marquis, like proof that he had no mind to stay. In Lu he had killed his wife to prove he had no divided loyalty; in Wei, one refused marriage was taken as a sign he meant to leave.

paras.zh: 司马迁在传末评论说：吴起曾劝武侯，地形的险要比不上君主的德行，可他自己在楚国施政「刻暴少恩」，严苛暴烈、少有恩惠，因此丢了性命。这是司马迁的评语。
paras.en: At the end of the biography, Sima Qian remarked that Wu Qi had once told Marquis Wu that strong terrain counts for less than virtue, yet in Chu he himself governed harshly and with little kindness, and that cost him his life. That is Sima Qian's own verdict.

paras.zh: 本篇只依据《史記·孫子吳起列傳》一个史源。文中的对话、士兵母亲的话、公叔仆人的计策，都是史书的叙述，未必是逐字记录；“猜忍”“贪而好色”“节廉而自喜名”分别是鲁国进言者、李克和公叔之仆对吴起的评价。标明“作者推断”的段落是本文的解读。
paras.en: This piece rests on a single source, the biography of Sunzi and Wu Qi in the Records of the Grand Historian. The dialogues, the soldier's mother's words and the servant's plan are the history's narrative and need not be verbatim. Suspicious and ruthless, greedy and fond of women, a man of integrity who prized his name: these are judgments of Wu Qi by, respectively, his accuser in Lu, Li Ke and Gongshu's servant. The paragraph marked as the author's inference is this article's reading.

scenario.zh: 一家小公司里，一位功劳清楚的核心成员被安排了一次试探：管理层假装公司要与另一家合并，想看他是立刻站队还是观望。他看出这是试探后当场请辞，管理层反而认定他本来就没打算留下。
scenario.en: In a small company, a core member with an unmistakable record is handed a staged test: management pretends the firm is about to merge with another, to see whether he immediately picks a side or watches and waits. He sees through the arrangement and resigns on the spot — and management reads the resignation as proof that he never meant to stay.

question.zh: 当你发现信任正被设计成一次考核，什么时候该解释、什么时候该等一等、什么时候该走？判断的依据应该是怀疑的程度，还是自己手上有没有能自证的事？
question.en: When you see trust being engineered into an examination, when should you explain, when should you wait, and when should you walk? Should the call rest on how far suspicion has already travelled, or on whether you hold something in hand that can speak for you?

assumptions.zh:
怀疑已经公开，不再只是传闻
试探已经执行，且不止一次的可能
还存在一条可以直接对话的渠道
手上有一件近期能出结果、能自证的事
assumptions.en:
Suspicion is already open, not mere rumor.
The test has been run, and may well be run again.
A direct channel of conversation is still open.
One piece of work in your hands will land soon and can speak for you.

steps.zh:
先分辨这是考核还是结论：若是考核，反应本身就是答卷；若是结论，解释只是补材料。
找一件两三周内能落地的事，用结果说话，而不是用表态说话。
同时看怀疑的走向：若试探接连出现、且不给解释机会，说明问题不在信息，在立场。
steps.en:
First decide whether this is a test or a verdict: if it is a test, your reaction is the answer sheet; if it is a verdict, explanation is only extra paperwork.
Find something that can land within two or three weeks, and let the result speak rather than declarations.
Watch which way suspicion is moving: if tests come one after another and no chance to explain is given, the problem is not information but position.

alternative.zh: 作者提出的替代选择：既不按剧本接招，也不当场离开，而是把这场安排摊开说破，逼对方把“留不留心”的判断变成一次明面的对话。代价是可能被视为挑衅，收益是把暗处的试探变成明处的谈判。
alternative.en: The author's alternative: neither play the part you have been handed nor walk out on the spot, but call the arrangement by its name and force the question of whether he means to stay into an open negotiation. The cost is being read as provocative; the gain is turning a test staged in the dark into a bargain made in the light.

uncertainty_note.zh: 本篇史源单一，仅《史記·孫子吳起列傳》（维基文库本）。文中对话、士兵母亲的话和公叔之仆的计策都是史书的记述，未必逐字实录。人物评语分别出自鲁国进言者（“猜忍”）、李克（“贪而好色”）和公叔之仆（“节廉而自喜名”）；这些是当事人的评价，不是史家的定论。吴起在楚国的改革与结局只概述史书所记。标为“作者推断”的段落属于作者解释；思考题中的场景是虚构的。
uncertainty_note.en: This piece rests on a single source, the biography of Sunzi and Wu Qi in the Records of the Grand Historian (Wikisource text). The dialogues, the soldier's mother's words and the servant's plan are the history's account and need not be verbatim. The judgments of Wu Qi come from his accuser in Lu (suspicious and ruthless), from Li Ke (greedy and fond of women) and from Gongshu's servant (a man of integrity who prized his name); these are the speakers' own judgments, not the historian's verdict. His reforms and death in Chu are summarized only as the history tells them. The paragraph marked as the author's inference is interpretation; the scenario in the question is fictional.
